limitations.description: Customer data has not been processed.
limitations.evidence_reference: All validations used synthetic data (seed 20260929). No customer data was processed in any certified run.

limitations.description: Airflow runtime has not been validated in a deployed Airflow environment.
limitations.evidence_reference: DAG file (airflow/dags/dq_validation_dag.py) structurally tested (test_dag_importable, test_dag_has_tasks). No Airflow instance deployed.

limitations.description: ClickHouse runtime connection has not been validated.
limitations.evidence_reference: 5 SQL schemas (sql/*.sql) + config stubs (configs/quality.yaml, settings.py) + docker-compose service implemented. No ClickHouse running. Client intentionally NOT in production code (security boundary enforced by gate 15).

limitations.description: Unicode beyond the tested ASCII synthetic dataset was not covered by the 3.3M test.
limitations.evidence_reference: 3.3M synthetic dataset used ASCII names only.

limitations.description: Near-duplicate detection was not part of this controlled validation.
limitations.evidence_reference: No near-duplicate injection. Platform has no near-duplicate rule in V1 rule set.

limitations.description: Peak memory and CPU were not measured in this run.
limitations.evidence_reference: Engine does not expose peak RSS via CLI output. Prior certified 3.2M run measured 2365 MB peak RSS.

limitations.description: Historical 2026-09-18 fixed-point verification remains environment-limited (required ZIP unavailable).
limitations.evidence_reference: hardening_fixed_point_verify.py requires DQAEIP-FINAL-CLEAN-REBUILD-RELEASE-2026-09-18.zip (not present on filesystem). This is a prerequisite for the SEPARATE historical fixed-point verifier, NOT a blocker for the current release gate.

limitations.description: O(N) engine memory profile — peak RSS 2365 MB at 3.2M rows.
limitations.evidence_reference: id_set grows with every row; documented in engine.py docstring. Bounded-memory design intentionally NOT implemented.

limitations.description: Runtime safety is cooperative audit-hook instrumentation, not a kernel sandbox.
limitations.evidence_reference: CPython audit hooks are cooperative; no kernel-isolation claim.

limitations.description: Filesystem metadata mutations (os.chmod/os.utime) not captured by audit hook.
limitations.evidence_reference: Production validation code does not call chmod/utime (AST-verified). Only maintenance fixer script does.
